capabilities: Browse a note's commit timeline grouped by day with named milestones
Compare any two versions as side-by-side, unified, or rendered diffs
Restore a paragraph, change block, or whole note with undo and link-impact preview
Resolve Git merge conflicts in a note from three panes
Search content that existed in past versions and see when it was removed
disambiguation: It only reads an existing Git repository; it never commits, pushes or creates one, so it is not a vault syncing or backup tool.
extras: Desktop only (it runs git); the community directory scorecard lists warnings for shell execution, direct filesystem access, vault enumeration and clipboard use, all explained in the README. Lab tools are hidden behind a setting and off by default. Full feature list exists only in Chinese in docs/FEATURES_zh.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or restore a note's past states when the vault is versioned with Git.

relations.evidence: Obsidian Git can do this on a timer.

summary: Git history browser for notes that shows a commit timeline, diffs any two versions, and restores a paragraph or whole note with undo, without committing.
